bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to energy; appropriating money to plan and construct an anaerobic digester or biomass thermal generation facility.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; BIOMASS ENERGY FACILITY. +]

[+(a) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, paragraph (j), $....... in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the renewable development account established in Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, to the commissioner of commerce for a grant to Liberty Diversified International to plan and construct an anaerobic digester or a biomass thermal generation facility in the city of Becker. This is a onetime appropriation. +]

[+(b) For purposes of this section, the following terms have the meanings given: +]

[+(1) "anaerobic digester" means a facility that uses diverted food and organic waste to generate renewable natural gas and biochar; +]

[+(2) "biochar" means a solid substance, made from burning organic material, that sequesters carbon and is capable of being used as a soil application; and +]

[+(3) "biomass thermal generation facility" means a facility that generates energy for commercial heat or industrial process heat from the combustion of organic material. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to energy; appropriating money to plan and construct an anaerobic digester or biomass thermal generation facility.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; BIOMASS ENERGY FACILITY.

(a) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, paragraph (j), $....... in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the renewable development account established in Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, to the commissioner of commerce for a grant to Liberty Diversified International to plan and construct an anaerobic digester or a biomass thermal generation facility in the city of Becker. This is a onetime appropriation.

(b) For purposes of this section, the following terms have the meanings given:

(1) "anaerobic digester" means a facility that uses diverted food and organic waste to generate renewable natural gas and biochar;

(2) "biochar" means a solid substance, made from burning organic material, that sequesters carbon and is capable of being used as a soil application; and

(3) "biomass thermal generation facility" means a facility that generates energy for commercial heat or industrial process heat from the combustion of organic material.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.
additions: (a) Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, paragraph (j), $....... in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the renewable development account established in Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, to the commissioner of commerce for a grant to Liberty Diversified International to plan and construct an anaerobic digester or a biomass thermal generation facility in the city of Becker. This is a onetime appropriation.
(b) For purposes of this section, the following terms have the meanings given:
(1) "anaerobic digester" means a facility that uses diverted food and organic waste to generate renewable natural gas and biochar;
(2) "biochar" means a solid substance, made from burning organic material, that sequesters carbon and is capable of being used as a soil application; and
(3) "biomass thermal generation facility" means a facility that generates energy for commercial heat or industrial process heat from the combustion of organic material.
This section is effective the day following final enactment.
